City Council Meeting – Budget Review
Time: Thursday 14 March, 10:00–12:00, Council Chamber, Civic Centre

Dear members, the March session will cover the draft transport budget, the library refurbishment tender and the Riverside parking proposal. Papers are in the shared drive under /council/2024-03. Please read the transport annex before the meeting.

The minutes assistant has already summarised the January session and flagged three open items; those summaries are attached for reference. Bring any amendments in writing to the clerk by Wednesday noon.

Coffee will be provided. Apologies to the clerk before Tuesday, 5pm.
